Welcome To PERINS
At Perins, we offer a supportive and vibrant environment where students are encouraged to achieve their full potential, both academically and personally. Our staff work closely with students to provide a broad, balanced education that inspires a love of learning.
We value community, positive relationships, and mutual respect, creating a place where students feel supported to grow in confidence and character. With a wide range of opportunities beyond the classroom, students are encouraged to explore their interests and develop new skills.
We invite you to discover what makes Perins such a special place to learn and grow.

PE Department Boot Donation Appeal – Supporting South Africa Sports Tour
As we prepare for our exciting Sports Tour to South Africa this July, the PE Department is reaching out to our school community for support.
We are looking for donations of clean, good-condition rugby boots, football boots, trainers, and netball trainers, please. These will be taken to South Africa and donated to the schools and clubs that our students will be visiting, coaching, and playing against during their time abroad.
This is a fantastic opportunity for Perins students to not only represent the school internationally, but also to give back and make a meaningful impact on the communities they meet. Your donations will go directly to young people who may not have access to the sports equipment we often take for granted, and they will be hugely appreciated.
If you are able to help, please bring any suitable footwear donations to the PE Office by Friday, 4th July.
Thank you in advance for your kindness and generosity. Every pair donated will help us to share the spirit of sport, community and opportunity across continents.

Attendance & Absence
There is a proven link between good school attendance and educational attainment and so we ask parents and carers to support us by ensuring their child comes to school as regularly as possible.
If your child cannot attend school please use our dedicated absence email, [email protected] stating your child’s name and tutor group as well as the reason for absence, or phone 01962 734361 (Option 1 – Absence).
Please inform us before 8.40am, the start of the school day. You must tell us on every day that they are absent.
If you need to apply for a school absence during term time, please download, complete and return the request form below to [email protected] at least two weeks in advance of any absence.
Absence Request Form
Fixed Penalties for non school attendance
Section 444A of the Education Act gives powers to the local authority, and Head Teachers to issue penalty notices in circumstances where it is believed that a person has committed an offence under Section 444A(1); that is, where a child fails to attend regularly at their registered school.

Help Us Spread the Word – Perins Open Events, Thursday 26th June
We’re excited to be opening our doors once again on Thursday, 26th June, for our upcoming Open Morning and Open Evening – two very different events that together offer a full picture of what life is like at Perins School.
If you know any families currently considering secondary school options, we would be grateful if you could help spread the word about our events. Your recommendation means a great deal and is often the reason new families discover our wonderful community.
You can find full details and register for the events here: https://perins.net/visit-join-us/open-days
Morning tours will be led by our fantastic students, giving families a real insight into daily life at Perins, while the Evening event is a lively and hands-on opportunity to meet our staff, try out activities in different subjects, and hear directly from students and teachers. Details of the activities we will be running can be seen below.
We’d also like to thank all our students in advance who are helping out on the day – whether guiding tours, leading activities, or representing the school in presentations, your involvement makes these events truly special, and we’re incredibly proud of you.
We look forward to welcoming new families to Perins and showing them everything our school has to offer.
Thank you for your continued support!

Perins Students in Royal Academy of Arts Young Artists’ Summer Show
Exciting News! Perins Students Submit Artwork to the Royal Academy of Arts Young Artists’ Summer Show
We are thrilled to announce that two very talented Perins students have submitted their artwork to the Royal Academy of Arts Young Artists’ Summer Show! This prestigious event showcases the creativity and talent of young artists across the country, celebrating their artistic expression and imagination.
The Young Artists’ Summer Show is a fantastic opportunity for students to have their work recognized on a national stage, with selected pieces exhibited at the Royal Academy of Arts in London and featured in an online gallery.
"We are incredibly proud of our students for their dedication, creativity, and courage in submitting their work, and we can’t wait to see how they do!" - Miss J Marsh - Teacher and Team Leader of Art
Watch this space for updates on their journey. Good luck to our young artists!

We’re pleased to share an exciting opportunity for you to support your child’s learning and wellbeing.
On Tuesday 6th May, from 6:00–7:00pm (BST), our partners at Elevate Education will be hosting a live Q&A webinar exclusively for parents. Elevate delivers high-impact workshops on study skills, motivation, wellbeing, and exam preparation.
This free session is designed to give you practical advice on how to best support your child at home, reinforcing the skills they’re learning in school.
👉 Click here to register for free
You'll also have the chance to submit your own questions and hear from experts during the live webinar.
If you’re not sure what to ask, why not check in with your child? Here are a few prompts to get the conversation going:
Is there anything about exams that’s worrying you?What would help you feel more confident or supported while studying?Are there things you’re unsure about in the run-up to exams?

Perins School Theatre Presents...
‘Legacy’ – The Best Is Yet To Come - 10th-12th July.
A spectacular musical showcase that takes audiences on a journey through the rich history of our past productions while celebrating the incredible talent shaping our future.​​
Revisiting highlights from our most iconic productions — reimagined by the incredible talent of our students and local community. From timeless classics to modern favourites, it's a celebration of the past and a look to the future!
Come be part of the story... because the best is yet to come.
More information and tickets will be released soon!

Exciting News - Grease: The Musical Auditions!
We’re delighted to announce auditions for our next whole-school production: Grease: The Musical!
Audition Dates (3:30–5 pm, Hub 1):
Tues 7 Oct – Years 7–8 Singing | Years 9–11 DancingWeds 8 Oct – Years 7–8 Dancing | Years 9–11 SingingThurs 9 & Fri 10 Oct – CallbacksThurs 16 Oct – Cast Announcement
Students wishing to audition should register their interest by completing this form before Monday, 6 October.
This is a fantastic opportunity for our young performers to showcase their talent and be part of an unforgettable production. We can’t wait to see them shine on and off stage!

Reflecting on the South Africa Tour 2025: A Journey of Sport, Culture, and Connection
As the South Africa Tour 2025 draws to a close, we look back on an extraordinary experience that has left an indelible mark on our Year 10 and Year 11 students. Over the past two years, students and staff have dedicated themselves to rigorous training and fundraising, culminating in this unforgettable 14-day adventure.
Sporting Excellence and Cultural ImmersionThe tour provided our students with the unique opportunity to compete against some of South Africa's top schools, showcasing their athletic prowess in rugby, netball, and other sports. These matches were not just about competition but about building bridges and fostering mutual respect through sport.
Beyond the playing fields, students engaged with local communities by running sport-specific workshops in the townships. This initiative allowed them to share their skills and knowledge while learning from the rich cultural tapestry of South Africa.
Exploring the Beauty of South AfricaWhen not competing, students had the chance to explore the natural wonders of South Africa. From the vibrant city life to the serene landscapes, the tour was a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. Highlights included surfing lessons and wildlife encounters, providing students with memories that will last a lifetime.
Building Lifelong ConnectionsThe South Africa Tour was more than just a sporting event; it was a journey that brought students closer together and deepened their understanding of global cultures. The friendships forged and the lessons learned will continue to inspire and shape our students long after their return.
We extend our heartfelt thanks to all the students, staff, and families who supported this endeavour. Your dedication and enthusiasm made this tour a resounding success.

pageCache.pageTitle: Ventus House Charity Fundraising Day - Thursday 9 October! - Perins School
pageCache.text:
Ventus House Charity Fundraising Day - Thursday 9 October!
Students are invited to join us at lunchtime under the new covered area in front of Pascal as Ventus House hosts their charity fundraising event in support of Winchester Young Carers.
This wonderful local charity works to improve the lives of children and young people with caring responsibilities, providing safe, high-quality support and a holistic approach to helping families thrive.
Hoodie Day - Students are invited to wear a hoodie to school tomorrow, in addition to their school uniform, in return for a £1 donation towards Winchester & District Young Carers.
Expect fun, games, and plenty of opportunities to show your support, all while raising funds for a brilliant cause! Please remember to bring some cash to take part in the lunchtime fundraising stalls and events.
“I am excited for our Ventus House charity fundraising day. We are pleased to be supporting a local charity that works to improve the lives of children and young people with caring responsibilities. They are providing safe, quality support to individuals and offering a holistic approach to the whole family.” - Ventus House Leader
We can’t wait to see our Perins community come together for this fantastic event!

Preparing Students for the Future at Perins
At Perins, we’re proud to offer our students the chance to step into the world of work through our Work Experience Programme, a powerful way to build confidence, explore career paths, and develop essential life skills.
“Work experience helps students discover the application of their own skills, talents, interests and aspirations within the context of work. It’s a vital part of their development and a brilliant opportunity to gain first-hand insight into the working world.” - Miss Amy Craig, Assistant Headteacher
This is just one of the amazing things we do here at Perins School to prepare our students for life beyond school.
If you are a parent/carer and missed the communication from school about this, please click here for all the information that you will need.

Transport Information
Transport to and from Perins
At Perins, we are committed to ensuring all students have access to transportation that is both safe and reliable to and from school. We understand the importance of a smooth and secure journey for our students, as it sets the tone for a productive day of learning.
Our transportation services are designed to cater to the diverse needs of our school community. Below, you'll find details about our in-catchment buses, out-of-catchment buses, and late buses, all of which are organised to provide the best possible service for our students and their families.
Our students not only travel safely but also use this time to bond with friends and enjoy each other's company. It's wonderful to see them making the most of their travel time.
Just the journey – your guide to smarter and safer travel to school
Eligible children living within the catchment area for Perins School will receive free transport to and from school through Hampshire County Council.
If you live within the catchment area and live far enough away from school to qualify for free transport, this will be provided by Hampshire County Council.
You will need to apply for transport soon after your child has been offered a place at Perins. The deadline for applications to Hampshire County Council is 31st May.
To apply for transport and for further details on eligibility, routes and replacement bus passes please visit the School Transport Website.
There are several bus operators that transport out-of-catchment students who attend Perins School. As prices change annually, please contact the operator for more information.
Public service:
Public buses cover students travelling from Winchester, Alton, and Petersfield.
Alton The number 64 Stagecoach public bus serves Alton.
Petersfield (via West Meon and East Meon) The number 67 Stagecoach public bus serves Petersfield, going via West Meon and East Meon.
Winchester, The number 64 and 67 Stagecoach public buses serve Winchester.
Private service:
Basingstoke Bus Services:
All services from Basingstoke are private arrangements between the parent and the operator. For September joiners, once your child has secured their place at Perins, please apply directly to your preferred operator by the deadlines shown below. For in-year transfers, places on the service will depend on availability.
Aldermaston Coach Lines
Aldermaston have introduced a new service starting in January 2026. The service incorporates pick up and drop off points in Rooksdown, Oakley, Bucksin, Kempshott, Beggarwood and Brighton Hill. The service is expected to expand to cover other areas and parents are asked to contact Aldermaston directly to express their interest in additional stops. The service also includes a bookable late service Monday - Thursday and leaves school around 5.15 pm.
The deadline for September joiners is 30th April.
Contact: Please email Jayne Jackson - [email protected] or call 0118 971 3257
Mortons have various pick up and drop off points across Basingstoke and the surrounding area. The bookable late service operates Tuesday-Friday and leaves school around 5.15 pm. The areas covered by Mortons can be seen here.
The deadline for September joiners is 31st May.
Contact: Please email [email protected] or call 01256 889082.
In order for students to attend our wide range of after-school activities, the 64 and 67 Stagecoach public services have stops conveniently located outside the school gates on Jacklyns Lane.
Mortons and Aldermaston run a late service back to Basingstoke at no additional cost. Mortons operates Tuesday - Thursday, and Aldermaston operates Monday - Thursday.
Please note: Parents will need to book their child onto the late bus directly with the operator.

Holiday Activities and Food Programme
Families of children receiving benefit-related free school meals, and other identified vulnerable families, can now book free places on the Holiday Activities and Food (HAF) programme for Summer 2025.
This fantastic scheme, funded by the Department for Education and coordinated by Hampshire County Council, offers a wide range of fun, enriching activities and nutritious meals throughout the summer holidays.
With over 180 activity sites across Hampshire, including schools, childcare providers, community groups and sports organisations, there’s plenty on offer to keep children active, engaged, and well-fed during the break.
Bookings are now open, places are limited, so we encourage eligible families to secure their space as soon as possible.
Visit the Family Information and Services Hub to find out more and book:Holiday Activities and Food Programme | FISH
If you have any questions, feel free to contact the school office.
